verdict: Static evidence ties the default material mutation route and result insertion to the same +0x70/0x17c pocket view. Material helper outcomes are not checked at the inspected caller boundaries. Result insertion is checked inside efac20 and its status propagates through efab90, but ee1420 calls ee17e0 afterward without testing that status. The maker marker attempt is therefore not success-gated in this path. This is not proof of successful debit, atomicity, rollback, quest completion, or durable save.
